A nourishing moisturiser formulated with 93% snail mucin and rice-derived ingredients to help support hydration, smoothness and a healthy-looking skin barrier. Its creamy texture is designed to leave skin feeling soft, comfortable and replenished.

Key Benefits

  • Helps support lasting hydration.
  • Helps improve the feel of dry or rough skin.
  • Supports a smoother-looking complexion.
  • Contains 93% snail mucin.
  • Features rice-derived ingredients.
  • Helps maintain a comfortable skin barrier.

How to Use

Apply an appropriate amount as the final step of your skincare routine. Gently spread over the face and pat until absorbed. Use morning and evening as needed.

Suitable For

Normal, dry and combination skin, especially those concerned with dryness, rough texture or a weakened moisture barrier.
